1: Habakkuk asks why God tolerates violence. God answers that he is raising the Babylonians. The prophet objects: they are worse.
2: The just shall live by faith
Habakkuk waits on his watchtower. The answer: the proud will fail, but "the righteous shall live by his faith". Five woes follow.
Paul builds his teaching on this line.
3: A prayer recalling God's mighty acts. "Though the fig tree does not blossom, yet I will rejoice in the Lord."
Faith that does not depend on circumstances.
